text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
On the eve of the Japanese Derby, 
Duramente received an encouraging phone 
call from her father, wishing for her to 
run safely without pushing herself too 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Jungle Pocket, an Umamusume 
who once conquered the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby), approaches Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Striving to be the strongest himself, 
Jungle Pocket says he came to see the 
strongest of the current era. And he asks— 
Are you truly the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente stated resolutely that the 
answer would be revealed today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente appeared in the paddock 
completely composed. Exuding the aura of 
the absolute strongest... she finally 
steps up to challenge the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby).
